name: Dispatch
description: Runs an overnight pass across email, Slack, LinkedIn and X DMs, spotting agreed calls that never became calendar invites and booking them, with a summary waiting in the morning. Requires access to all those inboxes and your calendar, so it suits people whose commitments get made in scattered conversations.

official.title: Dispatch by Filippo
official.description: A close-the-day desk. Nightly scan of email, Slack, LinkedIn, and X DMs; if someone agreed to a call and no calendar invite exists, book it. Morning...
